correctness.rationale: Fixing one vertex of a bipartition forces every opposite-part letter to occur once on each side of its two occurrences. Same-part nonalternation makes the remaining same-part occurrence intervals nested around that opposite-part block; opposite-part nonalternation then forces reversed order across the two sides. This yields the exact cyclic form ABA^RB^R. The converse is immediate from relative-order tests. Counting the two-to-one parameterization and primitive rotations gives the formulas. Exhaustive direct enumeration through m+n=5 independently agrees with the structural generator.

value.rationale: The direct source makes counting square-free representants a central problem, solves only the complete-graph case exactly, and shows non-complete connected graphs have infinitely many representants overall. The representation-number layer is therefore the natural finite layer to count. Complete bipartite graphs are the fundamental connected non-complete circle graphs, and the theorem gives both a full structural normal form and exact labeled/cyclic counts for the entire family.
